question.text: A biconvex lens of focal length $f$ forms a circular image of radius $r$ of sun in focal plane. Then, which option is correct?

options.text: If lower half part is covered by black sheet, then area of the image is equal to $\pi r^2 / 2$
If $f$ is doubled, intensity will increase

solution.text: $$ r=f \tan \theta $$ or $$ \begin{array}{lc} \text { or } & r \propto f \\ \therefore & \pi r^2 \propto f^2 \end{array} $$
